corrections.text: The article attributes the quote "is broadly used and very much loved by S3 customers today" (part of a longer Andy Warfield statement) to Amazon's own newsroom post at aboutamazon.com. That phrase does not appear on Amazon's newsroom page; it appears only in DuckLabs' own announcement and press release. The quote itself is genuine and accurately worded, but the citation should point to DuckLabs' materials, not Amazon's.
